title: eupatorium collinum var. mendezii
intro: Eupatorium collinum var. mendezii, commonly known as False Tansy, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in homeopathy to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Eupatorium collinum var. mendezii include relief from symptoms of influenza, fever, and rheumatism. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and alleviate inflammation, due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids.
